AGENDA
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
  NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  OCTOBER 4, 2022
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS AGENCY MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION
WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY
ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE ZOOM
MEETING BY CALLING: (669) 900-6833 OR USING THE ZOOM APP WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7095732685; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED
THROUGH ZOOM, FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3, OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE
  6:00 P.M.

  Rick Ramirez, Chair
  Ana Valencia, Vice Chair
  Tony Ayala, Board Member
  Jennifer Perez, Board Member
  Margarita L. Rios, Board Member

 Public Comment: See above.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
 services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the
 agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior
 to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to
 provide participation in the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Agency regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted
 will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00
 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk
 via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.
 CALL TO ORDER  Chair Ramirez

ROLL CALL  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  Secretary

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll
call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by the
Agency.

1. MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends the Agency approve the minutes of the regular meeting
  of September 6, 2022.  1305-03

2. WARRANTS - Staff recommends the Agency approve the warrant register for the period August 30,
  2022 through September 26, 2022, in the total amount of $352,875.00.  1310-01

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on
the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated this 30th day of September 2022.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
Secretary

  1305-03

  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA
  SEPTEMBER 6, 2022

Chair Ramirez called the hybrid meeting to order at 6:04 p.m. in the Council Chambers,
Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California, and via
videoconference pursuant to Assembly Bill 361. Responding to roll call in person were
Board Members Ayala, Perez, and Rios, Vice Chair Valencia, and Chair Ramirez. Also
present were Jesus M. Gomez, Executive Director; Gloria V. Ramirez, Agency Deputy
Counsel; and Theresa Devoy, Secretary.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one
motion and roll call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and
considered separately by the Agency. Board Member Rios moved and Board Member
Perez seconded to approve the consent calendar as recommended. MOTION
CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Board Members Ayala, Perez, and Rios, Vice Chair Valencia, and
  Chair Ramirez
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

MEETING MINUTES

The Agency approved the minutes of the regular meeting of July 5, 2022.  1305-03

WARRANTS

The Agency approved the warrant register dated June 28, 2022 through August 29,
2022, in the total amount of $752,250.  1310-01

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

None.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were no persons wishing to address the Agency.

  1

Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency
September 6, 2022

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business to come before the Agency, the meeting was adjourned
at 6:05 p.m.

  ___________________________
  THERESA DEVOY, CMC
  SECRETARY

____________________________
RICK RAMIREZ
CHAIR
